name: Enrique Orozco
diet: Flexible / IIFYM, High protein, Whole foods, Intermittent fasting
bio: Welcome! I want to help you transform into a hybrid athlete, lose the weight, gain the muscle! If I can, so can you.
story: I became a coach to help and push people to reach their goals, after I changed my life, I figured I wanted to share that with others. I ran my first ultra marathon, got visible abs, became healthier.
client_success: Success is defined as reaching the goals, regardless of how hard or easy the journey will be
other_notes: I want to work with the young men and women who are wanting to lock in and enjoy their life as they are developing it. I want to help dad's with dad bods gain confidence and be able to perform for their family. I work full-time, volunteer at different areas and I strive to be consistent with my fitness goals.

name: Hunter Hall
diet: Flexible / IIFYM, High protein, Whole foods
bio: I'm Hunter, a U.S. Army veteran, fitness coach, and yoga teacher. I'm passionate about fitness, personal growth, and helping people build healthy habits that last. Glad to be here and excited to connect with everyone!
story:
My name is Hunter, and I’m a U.S. Army veteran, fitness coach, and yoga teacher with a passion for helping people build confidence, strength, and healthy habits that last.

At 17 years old, I joined the U.S. Army and served for six years as a 15Y AH-64 Apache Armament/Electrical/Avionics Systems Repairer. During my military career, fitness was a part of everyday life through physical training, weightlifting, running, and ruck marches. What I enjoyed most wasn’t just improving myself it was helping others improve as well.

After leaving the military, I continued my passion for health and wellness by becoming a yoga teacher and fitness coach. Today, I combine the discipline and resilience I learned in the Army with a balanced approach to fitness, mobility, recovery, and mindset.

Through HunterFlowFit and Cherry Yoga, my goal is to help beginners and busy adults feel comfortable in the gym, build sustainable habits, improve their mobility, and create a healthier lifestyle without relying on extreme diets or complicated workout plans.

I believe fitness should enhance your life, not take it over. My mission is to help people train with intention, move with confidence, and become the strongest version of themselves both physically and mentally.
client_success: Success looks different for everyone, but for most of my clients it's building confidence, creating consistent healthy habits, and feeling stronger both physically and mentally. It's not just about losing weight or gaining muscle â it's about walking into the gym without feeling intimidated, having more energy throughout the day, moving better, and developing a lifestyle they can maintain long-term.
other_notes: I'm passionate about helping beginners feel comfortable in the gym and build lasting healthy habits. As an Army veteran, I bring discipline and accountability to my coaching, while also emphasizing balance, sustainability, and long-term success.
